correctness.rationale: The exact recurrence (n+1)c=(n+2)a+5b, adjacent pair gcd formulas and e=gcd(a,c)|5 are proved from first principles. Minimality for n>=3 follows from a cubic inequality and five finite cases. Applying the published full three-generator gluing iff criterion, nonnegative Diophantine coefficient bounds force q=gcd(n+1,6)=1 in the a,b orientation and exclude other orientations. The explicit Frobenius polynomial follows by gluing plus Sylvester. Independent Apéry-set checks for n<=40 and modular/gluing checks through 10000 corroborate the symbolic argument; neither is used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This settles a natural complete infinite classification for a classical figurate sequence rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The infinite congruence families, sharp all-index exceptions, explicit quintic Frobenius/genus, and 1/3 symmetry density provide a structural distinction from classical triangular, tetrahedral, and pure-power semigroup families. A general downstream theorem is not required; full classification of a motivated generator family is substantive.
